CustomActions_Config_ActionsDesc: Configure custom actions that appear in the search results action menu.
CustomActions_Config_ParameterLabel: Parameters (%s or {} = selected path; auto-quoted, don't add quotes yourself; left empty, the quoted path itself is used as the parameter)
CustomActions_Config_MultiSelectLabel: Supports multi-selection (passes all selected paths in one launch)
CustomActions_Config_ExtensionsLabel: Extension Filter (e.g. .txt,.log; empty for no limit)
CustomActions_PluginDesc: Custom actions plugin. Allows users to customize right-click context menu actions.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_DynamicActionProvider: Injects dynamic custom action menus in search results context menus, supporting external commands and parameter formatting.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_CustomActionsTranslatio: Provides translation keys and multi-language localization for Custom Actions.
